label: Mystery
prompt: A mysterious system with a frozen ocean world and a volcanic planet inhabited by underground creatures.

system.name: The Ember Veil
system.description: A frozen sea and a volcanic refuge conceal the traces of a vanished expedition.

star.name: Vesper
star.description: An amber star shines through a thin cloud of ancient cosmic dust.

planets.name: Thalassa
planets.surface: Lavender ice plains and violet fissures seal an ocean warmed by hidden mineral vents.
planets.atmosphere: A thin nitrogen haze carries drifting crystals.
planets.life: Ribbon colonies gather around warm vents beneath the ice.
planets.discovery: A repeating pulse rises from a tower buried in the ocean.

planets.name: Cindervault
planets.surface: Black basalt plains split around narrow rivers of molten orange rock.
planets.atmosphere: Dense sulfur clouds obscure the mountain peaks.
planets.life: Armored burrowers inhabit cool caverns beneath the lava fields.
planets.discovery: Their tunnels form a spiral visible in thermal scans.

planets.name: Echo Cairn
planets.surface: Copper dunes and dry channels surround the remains of a shattered observatory.
planets.atmosphere: A faint argon atmosphere settles in deep valleys.
planets.life: Dormant spores survive inside translucent stone shells.
planets.discovery: The observatory points toward the hidden tower on Thalassa.

label: Ocean
prompt: A peaceful blue star system with ocean life, an icy moon, and a ringed gas giant.

system.name: The Tidal Chorus
system.description: Three blue worlds shelter living reefs, frozen archives, and creatures drifting through clouds.

star.name: Azure
star.description: A pale blue star bathes the system in a steady silver light.

planets.name: Cantora
planets.surface: Turquoise shallows and coral atolls border a deep cobalt ocean.
planets.atmosphere: Warm oxygen-rich air carries fine ocean mist.
planets.life: Reef colonies communicate through slow waves of colored light.
planets.discovery: The reef songs repeat the orbital rhythm of all three worlds.

planets.name: Lacuna
planets.surface: Pale blue glaciers split along deep teal cracks above a hidden ocean.
planets.atmosphere: A delicate nitrogen veil forms luminous polar ribbons.
planets.life: Microbial mats grow beside heated cracks on the ocean floor.
planets.discovery: Ice layers preserve geometric traces older than the reefs.

planets.name: Zephyra
planets.surface: Jade and silver cloud belts spiral around deep green storms.
planets.atmosphere: Deep hydrogen clouds hold floating mineral droplets.
planets.life: Broad translucent floaters drift through temperate cloud layers.
planets.discovery: Fragments within the rings emit the same pattern as Cantora.

label: Ruins
prompt: The ruins of an ancient civilization around an orange star, with three very different planets.

system.name: The Relic Crown
system.description: Abandoned machines connect a desert world, a volcanic forge, and a giant encircled by debris.

star.name: Aurum
star.description: An orange star illuminates monuments left by an unknown civilization.

planets.name: Archivum
planets.surface: Charcoal plains and blue mineral veins surround the remains of sealed stone archives.
planets.atmosphere: Dry carbon dioxide air carries reflective mineral dust.
planets.life: Lichen grows inside the shaded doorways of sealed archives.
planets.discovery: A map carved into a tower marks a route through the giant rings.

planets.name: Ferrum
planets.surface: Yellow sulfur deposits surround rust-red calderas and abandoned basalt forges.
planets.atmosphere: Sulfur haze glows above ancient exhaust chimneys.
planets.life: Heat-resistant cave colonies occupy the abandoned forges.
planets.discovery: One forge still produces a pulse when Archivum crosses the star.

planets.name: Diadem
planets.surface: Violet and cream storm belts swirl beneath a ring of broken orbital stations.
planets.atmosphere: Dense hydrogen and helium clouds hide the lower atmosphere.
planets.life: No confirmed life appears beneath the station debris.
planets.discovery: A silent beacon in the rings points back toward the sealed archives.
